messages:
Clara: Tiny victory: my desk plant survived the weekend. I am now officially a plant parent. 🌱
Devon: Congrats! Name? Care regimen? Watering schedule? Do we have a baby registry?
Clara: Name is 'Spreadsheet'. Watered on Wednesdays. Loves Spotify ambient playlists.
Ishaan: Spreadsheet the plant will be our new OKR mascot. Proposal: emoji reaction goals for growth. :seedling: = watered, :sunny: = moved to window.
Mina: I'll make a tiny birthday card for Spreadsheet. Also petition to add a tiny tie for pair-programming days.
SnackBot: Reminder: office plants are not allowed on hot plates. And congratulations to Spreadsheet. Free cookies in kitchen for plant parents at 3pm.
Devon: Challenge issued: photo of Spreadsheet with a sticky note that says "deploy success" wins one houseplant sticker.
Clara: Photo incoming. Also accepting sticker donations.
Ishaan: Welcome to the club, Spreadsheet. May your leaves never hit merge conflicts.
Mina: (reaction) :laughing:
